description: fetchngs writes an atacseq samplesheet (every run as replicate 1 of its sample) with --nf-core-pipeline atacseq. Runs whose ENA instrument_platform is not a short-read platform (the ones nf-core/mag accepts as short reads: ILLUMINA, BGISEQ, DNBSEQ, ELEMENT, ULTIMA, ION_TORRENT, LS454, …) are refused: atacseq analyses short reads, and long-read, capillary or colour-space runs would be processed as if they were.
